name: Health record
duplicates: Health is drawn three times in the old Figma: in Inspection (健康 - add and remove disease or symptom), in the pig list (health management) and in the 健康与治疗 treatment file. This feature holds the one version built in the Inspection prototype.

entryPoints.label: A pig with a condition in the walk
entryPoints.control: A pig row with health tags

entryPoints.label: Attention row or health tag on the pig record
A Health task (vaccination, treatment) on a pig

addsTo.what: Health actions (Disease or symptom, Record treatment, Resolve conditions, Care instructions)
Health tags with care icon on every pig row

flow: Save: the finding appears as a row or tag

screens.name: Pig with open conditions and an ongoing one
screens.zh: 健康 · 需处理与持续

notes.purpose: Read a pig's health on the spot: what needs attention now (Fever, Poor appetite) and what is only recorded (Arthritis). Sow 000306.
states: Dead sow: conditions stay visible but cannot be changed.

elements.name: Health finding on the pig record
elements.shows: Attention row "Health · Fever · Treat in place · Day 2"; tag "Arthritis · 120 days"

states.when: Care is Monitor, Treat in place or Move to hospital pen
states.shows: Row in the attention block: condition, care label, "Day N"; band colour by care (hospital, treatment, monitor)
Tag "N days" in General details · Health; row scrolls sideways when it does not fit
A "Note" row among the health rows; opens the log, not a finding
No "Day N" text; ongoing tag reads "Duration unknown" in its accessible name

elements.logic: "Day N" counts from the recorded start. A condition stays visible until explicitly resolved.
elements.rule: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed.

issues: "Health" is the type on every attention row, the label of the Health row and an Actions group: three meanings on one screen.
Duration reads "Day 2" for attention and "120 days" for ongoing: same fact, two formats.
No sign whether treatment was given for Fever; Last treatment is absent until recorded.
A temperature of 39.5 sits in General details, far below the Fever row, unflagged.

notes.purpose: A condition recorded but needing no action: sow 000281 has Arthritis (120 days).

states.when: Every condition has care No action needed
states.shows: No attention rows; tag in General details and on the walk row; counts in the walk's Health lens

elements.logic: Not an alert. "A condition with No action needed remains recorded and visible until explicitly resolved."

rules: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed.
issues: A pig with nothing to do still counts in the Health lens and the pen map "N health", so the count does not mean work.

issues: A sideways-scrolling row hides conditions two and three, which have the longest history.

notes.purpose: The four care levels as they read on the walk list: the same Diarrhoea tag on 000801 now carries Move to hospital pen.

elements.name: Health tag
elements.logic: Class care-ongoing / monitor / treatment / hospital. The care words appear only in the tooltip and the row's accessible name. Tags needing attention sort before ongoing ones.
elements.rule: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed.

issues: Care differs only by icon and colour, which a text-only view does not show.
Hospital pen is a care choice only: nothing moves the pig.

states: Closed or removed meanwhile: "Finding closed - The record is retained in this pig's log."

elements.name: Finding facts
elements.shows: Thin · 000267 · Body condition · Day 12; Care · Monitor; Recorded 12 Sep 2026 · G. Hansen
elements.logic: Kind is Disease, Symptom or Body condition. Day count is stored as 1 and never advances in the prototype. Latest treatment line appears only when the pig's last treatment targeted this condition.
elements.rule: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed.

Edit finding, Record treatment, Resolve or remove only

elements.name: Resolve or remove
elements.rule: Recovery keeps the case in history; entered in error marks it as a correction. Saved changes keep the sheet on the finding.

issues: Four rows for one record; Edit finding and Resolve or remove both change the finding.

notes.purpose: Rename the condition, change its care and add a note.

states.shows: Name fixed; "Use Review feed adjustment to change the condition band."
Picker of every catalogue name the pig does not already carry

elements.name: Save changes
elements.logic: Writes the new name, kind, care and note; logs "Finding edited" with "old → new · old care → new care". A linked treatment target is renamed with the finding.
elements.rule: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed.

issues: The finding's start date and author cannot be corrected here.

notes.purpose: Close one finding as Recovered or Entered in error.

elements.name: Outcome and Save outcome
elements.shows: Recovered | Entered in error; Save outcome

states.when: Body-condition finding with a feed adjustment
states.shows: "This also ends the linked feed adjustment and returns this pig to the base plan."

elements.rule: Default Recovered. Save moves the case to the pig's closed cases, ends a linked feed adjustment (factor back to 1), logs "Recovered" or "Finding entered in error" and returns to the pig record. No second confirmation for Entered in error.

issues: Two names for one thing: "Resolve or remove" here, "Resolve conditions" in Actions.

notes.purpose: Add one or more diseases or symptoms to one pig or many in one move.

elements.name: Pig row

states.when: Condition not yet on the pig
She already has all chosen conditions

elements.logic: One pig shows only the Details panel, several show the list. Dead sows are not eligible.

elements.name: Care default
elements.logic: The same care is given to every added condition. The default is No action needed, so a newly recorded Fever does not need attention unless Care is changed.
elements.rule: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed.

elements.name: Save
elements.rule: Disabled until a condition is chosen and at least one row would change; N = pigs that would change. Writes one finding per pig and name, day 1, recorded 12 Sep 2026 by G. Hansen, plus one "Health recorded" log entry. A condition the pig already has is skipped and keeps its original start date. Returns to the walk list.

rules: One searchable disease/symptom catalogue for one or many pigs.
issues: Default Care "No action needed" makes the quickest path (choose Fever, Save) record a fever as a non-alert.
The Save label reads "Save · 0 pigs" while disabled.
The catalogue needs three levels (tab, door, item) for a gloved worker.

notes.purpose: Search or browse the disease and symptom catalogue and tick one or more.

elements.shows: Diseases and Symptoms tabs, category doors, items

Results grouped by category; matches name, category, section and aliases (PRRS, pig flu); "Add “name”" when nothing matches exactly
Asks for a category; removable with an x; kept for the session

elements.logic: Item row shows how many selected pigs already carry it ("Already on 1 selected").

elements.name: Done
elements.rule: Done keeps the choice; Back discards changes made in the picker.

edge: The disease and symptom hierarchy was translated from the Figma file.
rules: Diseases and symptoms are one catalogue and one picker.
issues: "Link condition" (for a treatment) reuses this catalogue with another layout: two near-identical pickers.

notes.purpose: Record medicine actually given, to one pig or many, without implying every pig got the same dose.

states.shows: List with a Dose column; a per-pig dose overrides the shared dose; a shared dose change clears row overrides
Titled "Record vaccination", vaccine list only, no condition chip, Save reads "Save"

elements.name: Dose and row state
elements.shows: Set dose for all / Dose · mL · mg · g

states.when: Medicine, method, unit or dose missing

elements.logic: Method: Injection, Oral, Topical, In feed, In water. Condition chip links only to pigs carrying that condition.

elements.name: Save
elements.rule: Disabled until medicine, method, unit and a dose above 0 are set. One treatment record per included pig; logs "Treatment recorded" or "Vaccination recorded"; a task completes on Save. Dead sows are excluded. Returns to the list, the finding, or the pig record.

edge: A task-triggered treatment may prefill the medicine but the user still confirms (the prototype prefills nothing).
rules: Medicines, methods and units should come from farm configuration.
issues: Medicines, brands and units are a sample list, not farm configuration.
Dose is "per pig" in one place and "for all" in another.
Record treatment from a finding and from the Health group differ only by the fixed condition.
